text: drones4health focuses set spectral, topographic, epidemiological indicators:
code: d4h_list_metrics() #> # A tibble: 5 × 4 #>   category        metric            resolution_cm application                               #>   <chr>           <chr>                     <dbl> <chr>                                     #> 1 Spectral        NDVI                          5 Vegetation vigor & biomass                #> 2 Spectral        NDWI                          5 Surface water & moisture detection        #> 3 Topographic     TWI                          10 Topographic micro-hydrology & pooling     #> 4 Epidemiological IEV (Stagnation)             10 Vector / snail breeding micro-depressions #> 5 Epidemiological IMSR (Synthetics)             5 Artificial container & waste risk sites

what: 3. Example: Calculate Epidemiological Indices from UAV Imagery
title: Ultra-High Resolution Drone Metrics for Spatial Health Analysis
text: indicator functions accept either terra::SpatRaster objects direct file paths, automatically handle CRS/extent alignment, mask background NoData:
code: library(drones4health) library(terra)  # 1. Calculate base spectral indices ndwi_layer <- d4h_ndwi(green = "data/green.tif", nir = "data/nir.tif")  # 2. Derive topographic indicators twi_layer   <- d4h_twi(dem_raster = "data/dem.tif") slope_layer <- d4h_slope(dem_raster = "data/dem.tif")  # 3. Calculate Vulnerability Stagnation Indicator (IEV) iev_risk <- d4h_iev(delta_ndwi = ndwi_layer, slope_dsm = slope_layer)

title: Ultra-High Resolution Drone Metrics for Spatial Health Analysis
text: Create operational spatial grids extract zonal summaries across survey area:
code: # Generate 50m operative surveillance grid surveillance_grid <- d4h_hex_grid(aoi = iev_risk, cell_size = 50)  # Summarize continuous raster layers over grid grid_summary <- d4h_summarize_grid(   raster_in = iev_risk,    cell_size = 50,    square = FALSE )
